result.reason: The clause adopts New York law and exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts located in New York County, satisfying the preferred position while retaining the existing injunctive-relief carveout. However, repeating the New York jurisdiction language in both Sections 28.1 and 28.2 is unnecessary; Section 28.1 could have been limited to governing law while deleting the Singapore venue language. The drafting is otherwise clear and professional.
